name: Checkmate Madness
detailed_description:
This game is developed not for profit and will be released for free after completion.

Become a Piece, But Never a Pawn.

You are no mere chess piece to be moved at will. Each investigator wields unique abilities—the Blade Master, the Demon Hunter, the Trickster… Will you carve through fear with a razor-sharp edge? Unleash gunfire to herald the hunt? Or whisper incantations to manipulate the battlefield? Your chosen path defines your survival.The Old Ones’ Pact: A Blessing and a Curse.

Combine the Pacts of eldritch gods with your learned Skills to forge endless tactical styles. Will you succumb to the abyss of madness or cling to the last bastion of reason? Master the chessboard and claim ultimate victory—your choices shape your fate.Death Is Not the End, But a Step Toward Truth.

Every defeat brings revelation. Through relentless cycles of exploration, refine your mind and strategy. Grow stronger, break the chains of destiny, and unveil the cosmos’ final secret—shrouded in layers of insanity.The Old Ones’ Shadow Looms Over a Shattered Board.

Where ancient rules have crumbled, only courage and wisdom can light the way. Stare into the abyss to survive this twisted game. Every decision is a gamble, every move a soul-shaking thrill—balancing on the razor’s edge between sanity and madness.

This Is Not Just a Game. It’s a Gambit Against the Gods. A trial of mind and madness. Are you ready to step onto the board?

short_description: Roguelike! Strategy! Cthulhu! When the chessboard becomes a gateway to chaos, and every move teeters between reason and madness, can you survive to the end in this game of wits against the Elder Gods?!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 chip or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or later / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD FX Series
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
